label: AB2_oI120_74_h2j_aef2i3j-001
title: Disordered Calcined AlPO$_{4}$-11 Structure
comments:
Samples of AlPO$_{4}$-11 were calcined at 873K to remove impurities and then dehydrated at 573K. Data was collected at 295K. 
 (Richardson, 1988) found \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oI120_46_b2c_2b9c_b2c-001}{an ordered structure}, but also found a good fit to the data by assuming this disordered phase where the aluminum and phosphorous atoms are randomly distributed. We arbitrarily label these mixed Al/P sites as aluminum. This randomization changes the space group from polar $Ima2$ \#46 to centrosymmetric $Imma$ \#74. 
 More information about AlPO$_{4}$ structures can be found on the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$} page. 
 (Richardson, 1988) give the data for this structure in the $Icmm$ setting of space group \#74.  We used AFLOW to transform it into the standard $Imma$ setting.
